segments.label: Historical heading
segments.original:
CAP. LXXI.
BANDO
Della Città di Beneuento, e suo Territorio.
segments.english:
Chapter 71
Proclamation
Concerning the city of Benevento and its territory.

segments.label: Explicit prohibition concerning Benevento
segments.original: Se bene nel Bando publicato colla sospensione del Commercio à tutto il Regno di Napoli, resta compresa anche la Città di Beneuento posta nelle viscere del Regno medesimo, nondimeno per maggior dichiaratione, e sicurezza, che non si ammettano gente, nè robbe, che vengano da quella parte, già che si presente esser in detta Città entrato il Contagio, co’l presente Bando d’ordine espresso di Nostro Signore si proibisce il Commercio alla stessa Città di Beneuento, & à tutto il suo Territorio, colle conditioni, e pene contenute nel Bando sudetto, publicato li 20. Maggio prossimo passato.
segments.english: Although the proclamation suspending movement and dealings with the whole Kingdom of Naples also includes Benevento, situated within that kingdom, nevertheless, for greater clarity and assurance that neither persons nor goods from that direction are admitted, since reports are heard that contagion has entered that city, this proclamation, by the express command of Our Lord, prohibits movement and dealings with Benevento and its entire territory, under the conditions and penalties contained in the aforesaid proclamation published this past 20 May.

notes.text: “Si presente” is understood as word being heard or reports circulating, not proof of a confirmed diagnosis. “Commercio” includes movement and dealings and should not be restricted to the sale of merchandise.

The opening says the earlier prohibition already included Benevento; this order explicitly reiterates its application. Its geographical phrasing is translated as the source’s assertion, not a determination of Benevento’s constitutional status.

relations.label: Restates the 20 May conditions and penalties for Benevento
